matrix.validation_freeze: one held-out light set was generated per seed before training and the same set object was evaluated for every representation/policy arm

training_config._comment: Torch training on the Mitsuba 'Country Kitchen' gallery scene (roadmap item 1). every seed-level mean of paired held-out-light PSNR deltas must be at least -0.5 dB
every seed-level mean of paired held-out-light PSNR deltas must be at least -0.5 dB
every seed-level mean of paired held-out-light PSNR deltas must be at least -0.5 dB
every seed-level mean of paired held-out-light PSNR deltas must be at least -0.5 dB

conclusions.note: R1A does not promote or authorize R2 unless a world-anchored arm passes the unchanged per-seed gate
